start.ergaenzt: Supplemented with matches of low signal quality.
start.seo_1: Soccer Intelligence is a platform for the statistical analysis of football matches in the Bundesliga, Premier League, La Liga and Serie A. We examine metrics such as goals, corners, yellow cards and shots on target in comparison with the league average.
start.seo_2: If match values deviate clearly from the usual level, we flag them as statistical anomalies. Using historical matches, we also check how often such anomalies were confirmed and derive the signal quality from this.
start.seo_3: This gives football fans and tipsters a data-based overview of interesting matches before kick-off.
start.seo_3_fett: We provide transparent statistics, but no betting advice or forecasts of potential winnings.

methodik_excel.titel: Soccer Intelligence – thresholds and signal quality
methodik_excel.hinweis: Statistical analysis of past matches. Not betting advice and no guarantee for upcoming matches.

regel.stark: Success rate of at least 60% and uplift of at least +8 percentage points
regel.mittel: Success rate of at least 55% and uplift of at least +5 percentage points
regel.gering: Success rate of at least 50% and uplift of at least +5 percentage points
regel.mindest: At least 50 matches, an uplift of at least +5 percentage points, a lower confidence limit above +2 percentage points and an advantage in at least two thirds of the seasons.
regel.schwelle: We test thresholds of 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30% and 35%. We use the threshold with the highest signal quality. If two thresholds have the same rating, we select the one with more matches. We recalculate the thresholds once per season.

erklaerung.trefferquote: Share of past matches above the threshold in which the expected result occurred.
erklaerung.vergleichswert: The same share across all matches in the league, regardless of the threshold.
erklaerung.spanne_links: Range of the uplift (95% confidence interval using the Wilson method), lower and upper limit. The fewer matches, the wider the range.
erklaerung.saisons_positiv: In how many of the analysed seasons the uplift was positive.
